race.description: Become A Member & Reap The Rewards Hcp (C1)
race.comment: Big field but WOLF JUNIOR (2) looks ready to fire. Placed both runs this time in and should be close to top now. Best form is here and looks set to go close. KNIGHTS REIGN (4) tried to lead throughout on the synthetic last time at Devonport and gave a sight but was nabbed late. Tricky gate here but will be in this for a long way. FIERCE 'N FABULOUS (3) comes through the same race, finishing a close-up fourth. Drawn for a soft run and looks a leading player. EQUIVASTER (7) is having her first try at this trip and only run close to it wasn't beaten far. Nice weight drop on last run and can give a sight. FUEL ON THE FIRE (1) has been freshened for this and continues to race well. Trip suits but will need a touch of luck off the wide gate.
